list: Official PS5 list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 1 possibly missable; all offline, one playthrough, about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn, because it only pops once the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut: finish the story, the 100% checklist, the stranger strands and every side counter, and this one follows on its own. Work the roadmap in order — story first, checklist second, strangers and cleanup last — and keep a manual save at each chapter break in case anything goes sideways.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is where the story starts, and this pops the moment you finish it — no extra step, no choice to get wrong. It is the first trophy most players will earn, and it stays hidden on PlayStation until it pops, so do not worry if you cannot see it in your list beforehand.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 1 ends. Just play the story through — the chapters roll into each other, and the trophy unlocks at the chapter break with no side requirement and nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 closer. Same deal as the other chapter trophies: complete the story missions in order and it unlocks at the end of the chapter, with nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 closer — play through the chapter's missions and it pops at the end. Three chapters down, two to go.

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 closer. Four chapters down, one to go; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission wraps up.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final story mission's trophy — finish the last mission and the credits roll with this in hand. It is the only gold trophy that stays hidden until it pops, so the name itself is a spoiler. After it, free-roam stays open for everything that is left.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Pops when you finish the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions cannot be missed — if it has not popped, you have not reached that mission yet, so keep playing the main thread.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so it comes to you in the main thread; no preparation or side work feeds into it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks by playing the story — nothing to hunt down first.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story-only, so it pops as you work through the chapter's missions.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission. It arrives in the story on its own; the airport setting is part of the mission, not something you need to set up yourself.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission trophies — once it pops, the story trophies left are the chapter closers and the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% completion trophy, and the hardest one by every guide's measure. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list: it is kinder than it sounds — roughly 60% of the game, with most tasks asking for only part of their total (70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals). The only parts that demand everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Expect around 100 hours after the story. When the checklist hits 100%, this pops, and the platinum follows if nothing else is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, bridge fly-unders, knife flights, base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one; stunts stack naturally if you drive fast and take ramps whenever you see them. Any mix counts, so pick the stunt types you find easiest and repeat them in different spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — the sports and pastimes scattered around Leonida, from fishing and arcade games to pool, mini-golf, basketball, shooting ranges, drone races and racing. You do not need to win or finish anything, just sample each one; the trophy pops on the ninth type. The exact nine the game counts are still being pinned down by the guide sites, so if one type does not register, try another pastime you have not touched yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has its own set of challenges; gold needs a clean, fast run, so learn the range layout, use the right weapon for the target distances, and retry the ones that miss — there is no penalty for retrying. This one is also required in full for 100%, so it is not optional for the platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own course; winning means learning the gates and the drone's handling rather than raw speed. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials, so the races and the trials share the same practice.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses, not the same one 20 times. Races are spread across Leonida (street, off-road, boat, air); work through the ones near you as you travel, and the count climbs on its own. The checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to that.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land the better catch in the time given. Buy the best rod and bait you can afford first, and watch the line tension — losing the fish costs the round. Cal shows up as a fishing rival; the challenge itself is the unlock.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Arcades are around Vice City; walk up to a cabinet, play a full game through to its end screen, and the trophy pops. It does not matter which game or whether you win — completing it is the requirement.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's final mission. Stranger strands build up over several missions — keep taking Andy's jobs when they appear and the strand ends with a final mission that pops this. Stranger missions stay open after the story, so there is no rush, but start a strand when it appears rather than leaving it all for the end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's final mission. Same pattern as the other stranger finals: follow Kenton's strand through its missions until the last one. Kenton goes quiet for stretches of the story, so if his icon vanishes, keep playing — he comes back.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's final mission. Finish Billy's strand; the last mission is the one that pops it. Like all stranger finals, it is still available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than eight strands in the game, so you do not need every one — pick the eight whose missions you enjoy or whose icons are nearest. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a strand of their own, and the rest come from other strangers you meet while exploring.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's strand to its last job. Randy's missions are tied to supply runs, so expect driving and delivery work along the way.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's final mission. Finish Tyrone's strand; the final mission pops the trophy. If a strand's icon disappears mid-story, it is a pause, not a loss — stranger content returns in free-roam.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and mind the first one. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia invites Jason to meditate on the balcony of his house in the morning; PowerPyx flags this as the one meditation that may not be repeatable later, and the only trophy in the game reported as possibly missable. Do it before you leave Chapter 1. After that, the other 17 spots are spread across Leonida and stay available; the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18, so the trophy needs three more than the checklist does. Keep a manual save at the end of Chapter 1 as a backup.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting work is a strand of its own: he points you at specific animals, and this pops when you take down the unique one he wants. Bret's target decks (15 of them) are also needed for 100%, so his strand does double duty.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; each set needs its full run of cards, and three finished sets pop the trophy. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so card hunting continues well past this one — use a map or checklist and clear one set at a time rather than grabbing cards at random.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Open WAiNK and scan landmarks, vehicles and points of interest as you travel — every new scan counts, and the app tells you what is left. It is a background trophy: scan whenever you pass something new and it fills up over the story. The checklist wants the same 100, so this and 100% move together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — a long list of small feats across combat, driving, exploration and more. You only need 50 of 80, and the checklist wants 70, so skip the ones that look miserable and take the easy half first; the counter is in Progress > Stats.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Get the cops to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. The partner matters — the trophy needs the two of you together, so start it from a mission or activity where your partner is present, then drive somewhere with cover and wait it out.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit a shop, keep the heat, and hit the next two before the stars drop — the trick is staying wanted the whole time, so do not hide between robberies. Pick three shops close together, plan the route, and keep your partner with you.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game counts a vehicle as discovered when you scan it with WAiNK or get in it — either way, variety is what matters, not repeats. Scan every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass; 100 comes quickly if you scan from the start, and the checklist wants 200 base models, so this is the halfway mark.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time — trigger it in a firefight with a group close together and drop five before it ends. Crowded spots with weak enemies are the place to try it; if the focus runs out early, retry — there is no cost to failing.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport — an unscheduled departure, as the description puts it. Get to VCIA, find a passenger plane ready to leave, and take it. Expect a heavy police response on the runway, so be ready to fly the moment you are in the seat.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos show up at military spots and in high-wanted responses; grab one, then put it to work — the trophy wants combat use, not just the theft. Driving a tank draws attention fast, so have an escape route in mind.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alert, and get out clean. Plan the approach — scope the store first, move when the staff are turned away, and leave before anyone notices the empty case.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big jobs — each one is a planned robbery with a getaway, and five of them pop this. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so this is a milestone, not the end of vault work.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida; ambush one, crack it open, and get away before the response arrives. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape part far easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map. Flying is the fastest way to fill in the dark patches: take a plane or helicopter across the state and watch the map fill in. The trophy pops once no fog is left anywhere.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are nine gangs with operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops. Operations are the gangs' side businesses — look for their markers while exploring, and tick the gangs off one at a time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites, so if it does not pop on the first try, try another beachfront spot or a different time of day — the method is being pinned down as players test it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car and drive it straight out through the showroom front — the trophy is about the exit, not the car. The precise showroom and conditions are still unconfirmed, so treat this as a try-it-and-see: pick a showroom, build speed inside, and go through the glass.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The guide sites report this as stealing the three key valuables at the bowling alley and escaping, but the exact method is still being confirmed. Go to the Kolt & Associates alley, look for the valuables, and get out clean — if it does not pop, the method is still being worked out by the community.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — reported as maximizing the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Build Strength through the activities that raise it (gym work, melee, heavy lifting) for each character until both are maxed. The exact stat check is still being confirmed, so if it does not pop at max, the trigger may be something else about the partnership.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — reported as performing 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Your profile tracks what you do in the world, and this counts the criminal actions adding up over a playthrough. It is a grind that fills in on its own if you play the criminal side of the game; the exact counter is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — a hidden trophy whose unlock is still unconfirmed. The description gives nothing away, and no guide has pinned the method down yet. It will likely surface as players compare notes; until then, there is no reliable method to give, and any claim otherwise is a guess.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — another hidden trophy with no confirmed method yet. The name hints at something strange in Leonida, and the guides list it as unconfirmed. Keep it in mind while exploring odd corners of the map, and check the guide sites as the community works it out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — reported as a melee drive-by elimination, likely at or near the bowling alley. Drive past a target and land the melee hit from the vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed, so treat the reported method as a lead, not a guarantee.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; your contacts clean them for a cut, and the total laundered is what counts. Keep robbing and fencing through your contacts and the quarter-million arrives on its own — the 100% checklist wants the same $250,000, so this and the checklist move together.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Everything you buy counts — weapons, clothes, food, car mods, property upgrades. It adds up fast over a full playthrough, so do not grind it; just buy what you need and check the total in Stats now and then.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — eight of them, per the guide sites. Garages are bought around Leonida and give you somewhere to store vehicles; buy each one as you can afford it. The money for all eight comes from the robberies and fencing you are already doing for the other trophies.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you find; scan and register ten different ones and the trophy pops. Any ten count, so register the first ten you come across rather than hunting specific models.
